title: Towards quantum elliptic cohomology from GLSMs
summary: This paper briefly outlines a proposal for a GLSM Coulomb-branch interpretation of the quantum elliptic cohomology rings currently being developed in mathematics by Bouaziz-Huq-Kuruvilla-Lee. The proposal is modeled on the established GLSM computations of quantum cohomology and quantum K theory of Fano toric varieties, where ring relations arise as critical loci of twisted effective superpotentials.
